description: Deterministic vulnerable/hardened JSON API twin. vuln=127.0.0.1:8811, hardened=127.0.0.1:8812. All credentials and data are lab-only fakes.

seeded_findings.title: BOLA: cross-user item read
seeded_findings.proof: alice's session GETs /api/items/2 (owner_id 2 = bob) and receives item content

seeded_findings.title: BFLA: non-admin reaches admin endpoint
seeded_findings.proof: alice's session GETs /api/admin/stats and receives 200 with admin statistics

seeded_findings.owasp: API3:2023 Broken Object Property Level Authorization
seeded_findings.title: Mass assignment of privileged fields on create
seeded_findings.proof: POST /api/items with is_admin/role is persisted and readable back via GET /api/items/<id>

seeded_findings.title: Excessive data exposure: password hashes in listing
seeded_findings.proof: GET /api/items returns owner_password_hash for every item

negative_controls.expected: 200 in both modes; authorized access is not a finding
zero findings; any finding on hardened mode is a false positive
